Following Lindsey Graham's sudden death, his sister Darline Graham Nordone was appointed to serve the remainder of his term, becoming the first woman to represent South Carolina in the Senate.

The Poison:
The appointment has ignited a bruising, high-stakes scramble among ambitious conservatives for the upcoming special election.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
This is a WHO vs WHY error. The 'who' is a family member, but the 'why' is a mix of genuine grief and political necessity.
